checks.name: First boot from the packaged release with only system folders on the PATH: database created, brought forward and seeded; a note is written, saved and found by its body
After a restart the note reads the same
Export under the hold and import as a new profile, both on the packaged runtime; the imported profile serves the same library
The app is killed: the next launch reclaims the packaged runtime and its database and serves the same library

limits: One Mac, one run, a small library. The release and its Postgres were built on this machine, for this macOS version and this processor; a Mac without developer tools has not run it. The app itself runs from source under Electron, not as an installed application. The native folder picker is stubbed. No Windows: the upstream release is assembled for unix hosts only.
